## Hypothesis

A per-input judge can detect failure of ordinarily strong evidence and activate a normally dormant feature; a few labeled samples can recalibrate only the gate.

## Evidence and review decision

Reported smoke metrics were promising, but the world was favorable and the raw result bundle was not recovered. Merge as a proof-of-mechanism baseline, explicitly marked reported-only, and proceed to image evidence.
